description: Searches the official texts on data protection (GDPR, ePrivacy, AI Act, EDPB guidance, CJEU case law, and the national law, authority guidance and decisions held for each country) and returns the most relevant passages verbatim, each with its current status (in force, applicable from a date, amended) and its official link.

country.description: ISO code of an EU or EEA country (e.g. FR, DE, ES) to add its national law and authority guidance to the EU texts; omit for EU texts only.

question.description: The legal question, in any language (French gives the best results today). Names and personal data are not needed.

name: search_law
title: Search EU data protection law
